description: List this workspace warehouses with id, name, description, phone, address (the street line), country (ISO code), city, postalCode, workingHours (free text), pickupEnabled (a self-pickup point), kind (own — the shop's stock; supplier — a supplier's showcase it sells from; fulfillment — a marketplace's warehouse such as Amazon FBA, kept by the marketplace and never a product's own), lowStockThreshold (null = each product's own mark) and allowNegative; stockPerWarehouse says whether the workspace keeps a count per warehouse. A product is filed under one primary warehouse, which decides the inventory-tracking default and which channels new products join. Use an id here as the warehouseId for create_product (never a fulfillment one), list_warehouse_stock or set_channel_warehouses.
name: list_warehouses
title: List warehouses
